UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Student profile, A/L academic details, reminder preferences, starting balance, and summary counters.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the student.

schoolName.description: School name (defaults to Royal College, Colombo).

subjects.description: Up to 6 A/L subjects (3 primary subjects).

reminderEnabled.description: Whether daily check-in reminders are enabled.

countExcusedAsPresent.description: Whether Medical and School Event days count toward 80% eligibility.

priorPresentCount.description: Optional prior days attended before joining mid-term or imported from attendance percentage.

priorAbsentCount.description: Optional prior days missed before joining mid-term or imported from attendance percentage.

baselineStartDate.description: Optional ISO start date (YYYY-MM-DD) of an imported percentage period locked from day-level edits.

baselineEndDate.description: Optional ISO end date (YYYY-MM-DD) of an imported percentage period locked from day-level edits.

baselinePercent.description: Optional imported attendance percentage (0-100) covering the locked baseline period.

setupCompleted.description: Whether initial academic setup is finished.

presentCount.description: Denormalized count of logged present days.

absentCount.description: Denormalized count of logged absent days.

medicalCount.description: Denormalized count of logged medical excused days.

schoolEventCount.description: Denormalized count of logged school event days.

lastCheckInDate.description: Optional ISO date string (YYYY-MM-DD) of last check-in.

photoUrl.description: Optional Google account profile photo URL.

customAvatarBase64.description: Optional compressed custom avatar JPEG encoded as Base64 for cross-device sync.

onlineNow.description: Whether the student currently has the app open in foreground.

guestObserver.description: Admin-managed demo/observer flag detaching teachers or old boys from live school stats, polls, streaks, and online presence.

lastSeenAt.description: Server timestamp of the student's latest presence heartbeat.

AttendanceRecord.title: AttendanceRecord
AttendanceRecord.description: Single school-day attendance entry keyed by ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD).

userId.description: Owner UID matching parent user document.

dateKey.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD matching document ID.

subjectTags.description: Optional bounded list of A/L subject tags.

note.description: Optional short note or excuse reason.

Notice.title: Notice
Notice.description: School-wide or stream/class-targeted notice or pinned dashboard slide.

pinned.description: Whether displayed in the 5-second dashboard slideshow.

targetValue.description: Optional grade, stream name, or class code when targeted.

AcademicTerm.title: AcademicTerm
AcademicTerm.description: Sri Lankan school term date range and eligibility requirement.

name.description: Display term name such as Term 1 2026.

active.description: Whether this term is currently active.

CalendarEvent.title: CalendarEvent
CalendarEvent.description: Sri Lankan Full Moon Poya day, public holiday, term break, or exam date.

title.description: Event name such as Vesak Full Moon Poya Day.

description.description: Optional extra details or admin note (e.g., no teaching advisory).

targetType.description: Optional legacy audience scope (defaults to all).

targetValue.description: Optional legacy grade, stream, or class code when targetType is not all.

targetAll.description: Optional multi-audience flag indicating visibility to all students.

targetStreams.description: Optional list of targeted A/L streams.

targetClasses.description: Optional list of targeted class codes.

targetUserIds.description: Optional list of targeted individual student UIDs.

AppSettings.title: AppSettings
AppSettings.description: Global application defaults and GCE A/L exam target dates.

al2026ExamDate.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD for 2026 A/L exam start.

al2027ExamDate.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD for 2027 A/L exam start.

al2028ExamDate.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD for 2028 A/L exam start.

nextDayPollEnabled.description: Whether the 8:00 PM - 5:00 AM Next-Day School Poll feature is enabled globally.

schoolStartDate.description: Optional ISO date YYYY-MM-DD marking the school/A-L journey start date before which attendance cannot be logged.

directApkDownloadUrl.description: Optional admin-configured HTTPS direct APK download override URL.

directApkVersion.description: Optional version tag or code corresponding to directApkDownloadUrl so stale links auto-fallback.

FeedbackReport.title: FeedbackReport
FeedbackReport.description: Student-submitted bug reports and feature suggestions.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the reporting student.

userName.description: Display name of the reporting student.

userEmail.description: Email address of the reporting student.

type.description: Whether this is a bug report, feature suggestion, or missing subject/class catalog request.

message.description: Detailed description of the bug or idea.

CommunityStats.title: CommunityStats
CommunityStats.description: Privacy-safe public counter of total registered accounts shown on Home.

totalAccounts.description: Total number of registered student accounts.

BroadcastNotification.title: BroadcastNotification
BroadcastNotification.description: Admin-dispatched custom notification targeting everyone or multiple selected audiences.

sentByEmail.description: Email of the admin who released the notification.

AcademicCatalog.title: AcademicCatalog
AcademicCatalog.description: Admin-managed GCE A/L subject buckets per stream and class lists per grade and stream.

streamSubjectBucketsJson.description: JSON map of stream -> bucket -> subject list.

gradeStreamClassesJson.description: JSON map of grade|stream -> class code list.

NextDaySchoolVote.title: NextDaySchoolVote
NextDaySchoolVote.description: Time-windowed (8:00 PM - 5:00 AM) student vote indicating whether they plan to attend the upcoming school day.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the voting student.

targetDateKey.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD of the upcoming school day.

going.description: true = Coming to school, false = Not coming.

grade.description: Optional A/L grade for aggregated class pulse.

alStream.description: Optional A/L stream for aggregated pulse.

className.description: Optional class code (e.g., 13M2) for classmate summary.

reasonTag.description: Optional anonymous reason chip for attending or skipping tomorrow.

ClassStreakEntry.title: ClassStreakEntry
ClassStreakEntry.description: Zero-PII opt-in class streak arena & weekly squad challenge entry keyed by student UID.

displayAlias.description: Opt-in nickname or Anonymous Student alias (max 24 chars, zero PII).

bestStreak.description: Personal best consecutive attended school days.

weeklyAttended.description: Days attended in current ISO week (0-7).

weeklyTotal.description: Counted school days in current ISO week (0-7).

optedIn.description: Whether the student has opted in to appear in the Class Streak Arena.

BlockedEmailEntry.title: BlockedEmailEntry
BlockedEmailEntry.description: Admin-managed blocklist of removed accounts keyed by lowercase email address.

email.description: Normalized lowercase email address blocked from accessing the app.

userId.description: Optional former Firebase Auth UID of the removed account.

displayName.description: Optional display name of the removed user for admin reference.

blockedByEmail.description: Admin email that created the block.

/users/{userId}.description: Student profile and denormalized attendance counters isolated per authenticated user or verified admin.

/users/{userId}/attendance/{dateKey}.description: Per-day attendance records scoped to each student.

/notices/{noticeId}.description: School-wide and stream/class-targeted notices and pinned dashboard slides.

/calendar_events/{eventId}.description: Shared Sri Lankan Poya days, public holidays, and school calendar dates.

/feedback/{feedbackId}.description: Student bug reports and feature suggestions.

/broadcast_notifications/{notificationId.description: Admin-released custom notifications targeting one or multiple audiences.

/app_config/{configId}.description: Admin-editable structured subject buckets and grade/stream class catalog (academic_catalog).

/next_day_votes/{voteId}.description: Zero-PII daily roll-call votes keyed deterministically by {targetDateKey}_{userId}.

/class_streak_entries/{userId}.description: Zero-PII opt-in class streak arena entries with rate-limited +1 peer cheers.

/blocked_emails/{blockedEmail}.description: Admin-managed blocklist keyed by lowercase email; users may only read their own email entry.
